mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 3.0% indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline in same month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances during late-cycle expansion when INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST) above 2000.0 thousand units indicate robust residential construction, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 2000.0.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 195.0 indicates accelerating inflation, triggering central bank rate hikes that reduce equity valuations and cause negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 195.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous slowing of employment growth (PAYEMS) below 0.5% and rising unemployment (UNRATE) above 5.0% indicate labor market contraction, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS growth < 0.5% and UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, FEDFUNDS exceeding 4.0% signals aggressive rate policy that reduces equity attractiveness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.
